art_direction: Native-scale late-1990s military pixel/cel tanker with a long fuel fuselage, broad long-range wing, four engines, transfer station and high-visibility service markings.
camera: Orthographic top-down, nose-left masters sharing one registered 112x64 canvas and pivot.

source.method: Deterministic authored native-resolution pixel/cel construction; no provider render is promoted.

runtime.animation: Directional silhouettes retain one tanker construction and registration while changing wing foreshortening, flank light, engine heat and navigation lamps.

review.integration: Existing hose, rendezvous cue and transfer instrument remain independent registered gameplay layers.
